description: Elevation in meters and feet with grid resolution in meters. Choose lat and lon for one sample, points for supplied coordinates in order, or path with samples for evenly spaced great-circle samples including both endpoints. Lists and paths use one pooled request. Unknown elevations stay null.

path.description: Path with 2-512 vertices as lat,lon pairs separated by |, or enc: followed by a Google polyline. At most 12000 characters. Segments follow the shortest great-circle arc. Segments with antipodal endpoints are invalid. Requires samples. Omit lat, lon and points.

points.description: lat,lon pairs separated by |, or enc: followed by a Google polyline. At most 512 points and 12000 characters. Omit lat and lon.

samples.description: Number of evenly spaced samples along the path, including both endpoints. Required with path and invalid without it.

name: elevation
title: Elevation
